methods.tail: All records at or above the ceil(N/20)-th longest length; boundary ties included
methods.tactics: Presence per proof from existing approximate lexical exports; not runtime call counts
methods.equal_source_mean: Unweighted arithmetic mean across the five sources with a nonempty primary population
